name: Western Astrology
policy: 80/20 practical scope, not measured percentage coverage or exhaustive historical completion

original_inventory_dimensions.note: Original six named variations preserved as separate configurable dimensions; returns and time-lords are explicit additional applications.

natal.positions: apparent geocentric true ecliptic/equinox of date; outer system barycenters
natal.orbs: explicit configurable major-aspect orbs in [0,15) degrees
natal.time: Pinned IANA data; DST gaps rejected and folds explicit; UTC/TT/modeled UT1; pre-1972 proleptic UTC
natal.dates: Astronomical UTC/TT epochs restricted to 1850–2149; internal epochs must also fit. Not an ancient-date release.
natal.latitude: Whole-sign/equal: strictly between poles; quadrant systems explicitly reject abs(latitude) >= 90 - obliquity, no fallback. Broad polar interpretation not claimed.
natal.interpretation: Source-scoped compositional components. Modern Sun/Moon/Mercury, signs, houses and aspect themes; traditional planets/houses/aspects. Other missing components and all direct natal pair gaps explicitly labeled.

features: chronological grouping without lost event data
transits.interpretation: 29 source-specific modern pair records plus exact-tradition compositional components; source gaps remain visible.

secondary_progressions.age: 0–150 symbolic years, including requested future window
features: progressed Moon contacts and lunation boundaries
secondary_progressions.interpretation: Modern lunar-phase and natal-house context. No modern reading silently assigned to traditional profiles. Direct pair delineations deferred.

solar_returns.interpretation: Shea nonprecessed tropical Placidus methodology, separately composed modern house topics and selected inner retrograde symbolism. No book planet-house or direct pair readings claimed.

profiles: medieval Lilly-profile dignities, proximity and reception
features: annual whole-sign profections and explicit birthday policy
traditional.limits: Geometric visibility only; no arbitrary strength score or complete historical perfection doctrine.

features: single Loosing of Bond per parent
zodiacal_releasing.window: Up to five civil years per query within 120 symbolic years after birth

experimental.electional: Ramesey unused-money retention and rapid-use partial searches only; diagnostics/classifications retained. No complete eligible election certified; source-incomplete candidates stay indeterminate.
experimental.releasing_L3_L4: Calculation retained and table/unit/boundary tests pass; published absolute L3/L4 chronology not independently verified.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: All existing 59 tests and targeted additions pass; retain independent astronomical fixtures
JSON smoke tests for every public calculation command and Markdown forecast/return/releasing outputs
Supported/experimental/unsupported matrix, source isolation and P1/P2 backlog frozen
Pinned runtime metadata/notices audited; no prohibited runtime or full-text distribution introduced

numerical_precision: Root brackets and fixture tolerances are documented per module; neither equals birth-time certainty or predictive validity.

acceptance_evidence.closure: Resolve commit with git log --grep='close Western Core v1'
